provider_custody.kind: offline pinned local loader plus Python audit narrow loopback capability policy
provider_custody.boundary: New compatibility policy declared before a new sole suite; does not attribute historical v2 bind. Explicit --provider-source canonical path hash and bounded fresh source SHA256 frozen. Only one import-phase socket.bind is allowed per ML worker: Windows AF_INET6=23, SOCK_STREAM=1, protocol=0, original exact tuple2 (::1, integer0), nearest exact source frames _has_ipv6@127 and <module>@137, both pinned source/path, exactly two saved urllib3 frames and one outside-package boundary inspection. No other bind/connect/DNS/sendto event allowed. Synthetic socket.connect audit denial creates no socket and is separate. No native-network sandbox or external-provider evidence.
provider_custody.diagnostic_scope: Record at most4 real network audit events; overflow increments separate count and denies. At most8 initial contiguous urllib3 source frames and9 scans, bounded source read1MiB; stop at first outside frame without saving its path/locals. Save only package-relative paths, canonical path SHA256, source SHA256, function/line, socket metadata codes and fixed endpoint classifications, event phase/time/decision. No actual address, port, user path or locals. Truncation, incomplete source hashing, invalid metadata, nonexact callsite or any denied/overflow event prevents success. One allowed import diagnostic persists byte-for-value across later stages and terminal receipts; its monotonic timestamp must lie inside the recorded import interval.
